question: From which of the following countries the Asia Cup 2022 was shifted out to the United Arab Emirates?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sri Lanka**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Asia Cup 2022 was originally scheduled to be hosted by Sri Lanka.
 
• Due to the economic and political crisis in Sri Lanka, the tournament was shifted to the United Arab Emirates (UAE).
 
• The decision to move the tournament was made to ensure the smooth and safe conduct of the matches.
 
• The UAE had previously hosted the Asia Cup in 2018, making it a familiar venue for the participating teams.
 
• The Asia Cup 2022 was held in the T20 format to serve as preparation for the ICC T20 World Cup.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Economic and Political Crisis in Sri Lanka:**

 
 
• Sri Lanka faced a severe economic crisis marked by shortages of essential items such as fuel, food, and medicines.
 
• Political instability further exacerbated the situation, leading to widespread protests and changes in government leadership.
 
• The crisis impacted various sectors, including tourism and sports, making it challenging to host international events.
 
 
 
• **UAE as a Cricket Venue:**
 
 
• The UAE is known for its state-of-the-art cricket infrastructure, including stadiums in Dubai, Abu Dhabi, and Sharjah.
 
• It has hosted several major cricket tournaments, including the IPL and previous editions of the Asia Cup.
 
• The country's neutral venue status often attracts international cricket matches.
 
 
 
• **Asia Cup Overview:**
 
 
• The Asia Cup is a men's One Day International and Twenty20 International cricket tournament.
 
• It was established in 1983 by the Asian Cricket Council to promote goodwill among Asian countries.
 
• India, Pakistan, Sri Lanka, Bangladesh, and Afghanistan are the primary participating nations.
 
 
 
• **Impact on Teams:**
 
 
• Shifting the tournament to the UAE provided a neutral ground for all participating teams.
 
• Teams had to adapt to the hot and humid conditions of the UAE, which can affect player performance and strategies.
 
• The change in venue also impacted logistical arrangements, including travel and accommodation plans for teams and officials.
